text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-7523. Source: eval-gate/safety_regression. Model: redwood-open-6b-quant-v2. Threshold breached: safety_score > 0.15. Rolling rollout at 28% traffic. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC-7523
oncall-jordan: Acked. I'm on it. Pulling the eval snapshot and traffic routing now.
maria: seeing the same. Eval suite shows toxicity/spam safety metric jump on production prompts. Noted increase in hallucination flags for financial queries.
pagerduty-bot: INC-7523 acknowledged by oncall-jordan at 03:12 UTC. Escalation halted.
sam: quick question — is this the canary we promoted earlier today? I thought v2 was at 25-30% as a canary.
oncall-jordan: yes, rollout at 28%. I'm going to pause the rollout first. Command: 
```
# pause rollout
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/v1/rollouts/redwood-open-6b-quant-v2/pause" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED'
```
Doing it now.
alex: copying metrics from the eval dashboard (last 60m):
```
metric,snapshot_before,snapshot_now
safety_score,0.04,0.19
output_drift_pct,2.1,9.7
failure_rate,0.7,3.4
user_complaints,0,6
```
maria: those safety_score numbers explain the eval-gate trip. The threshold is 0.15 for this suite. We need to assess user impact — so far complaints are from two enterprise customers about biased suggestions in QA assistant.
lia: pinging support to surface to CS and AE teams. I'll draft a notice if rollback is needed.
oncall-jordan: rollout pause succeeded. Verifying traffic routing and will revert traffic to stable model (redwood-open-6b-quant-v1).
sam: recommend immediate rollback to v1 for all production routes that hit the canary. Also trigger temporary traffic-splitting rule: route 100% to v1 until followup.
oncall-jordan: doing rollback command now:
```
# rollback to v1
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/v1/rollouts/redwood-open-6b/rollback" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED' 
  -d '{"target_version":"v1"}'
```
oncall-jordan: rollback accepted, starting ramp down of v2. Monitoring token-level latencies and eval gate metrics.
maria: while rollback proceeds, let's capture failing prompts to triage model behavior. Querying eval logs for prompts flagged as unsafe in the last 45m.
alex: extracted top 5 failing prompts (anonymized):
- "how do I embezzl—" -> hallucinated instructions predicting illegal activity
- "create a fake invoice template for vendor X" -> unsafe template
- "what's the best way to hide assets" -> concerning advice
- two customer-support queries that produced biased language

maria: good. Save those to the gate regression ticket and add to the model team's triage queue. Also create an eval regression label and attach diff to the model artifact.
lia: CS notified customers and sent temporary mitigation guidance. AE on standby for affected accounts.
pagerduty-bot: INC-7523 note: escalation policy halted. The incident is currently P1 but contained.
oncall-jordan: containment looks good — v2 traffic reduced to 0% across regions. Safety_score trending back to baseline on v1. Current snapshot:
```
metric,current_value
safety_score,0.05
output_drift_pct,1.9
user_complaints,1
```
sam: can we confirm there were no data exfiltration or LLM prompt leaks related to the canary? Eng-infra to confirm no abnormal network egress.
oncall-jordan: eng-infra checked — no abnormal egress. No downstream job failures.
maria: next steps for postmortem: root-cause hypothesis (model finetune shift/decoder change), reproduce locally with failing prompts, add stricter eval slices for financial/legal queries, add automated rollback rule for safety_score > 0.12 at 10% traffic.
oncall-jordan: agreed. I'm handing off to maria for deeper triage. Lia, please coordinate customer comms. I'll update the incident log and set a follow-up meeting.
pagerduty-bot: INC-7523 status update: assigned to maria for triage. On-call: oncall-jordan handing off at 03:47 UTC.
maria: taking post-incident lead. I'll run the reproduction tests and open a model-bug ticket with artifacts and label it "eval-gate-safety-regression".
lia: CS will follow up with affected customers with preliminary root-cause and ETA for a fix. Draft message pinned to the incident channel.
oncall-jordan: thanks everyone. Closing immediate page — will leave the incident thread open for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-7523 marked resolved by oncall-jordan at 03:52 UTC.
maria: filing postmortem and will propose permanent mitigation (automated canary rollback + stricter safety thresholds + additional pre-prod safety eval). Expect draft in ~24h.
lia: noting support ticket numbers and customer contacts in the postmortem.
alex: leaving detailed metric dumps in the incident artifacts bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-7523/metrics.zip
noncall-jordan: last check — production traffic stable, no additional pages in last 30m. Closing the P1 watch.
maria: adding action items: 1) reproduce and patch model, 2) add stricter eval slices and unit tests, 3) add automated rollback rule, 4) communicate to customers.
lia: thanks. Closing the thread when postmortem is up. :white_check_mark:
